---
pagetitle: "Research — Enrico Wegner"
description: "My main fields are macroeconometrics and time series econometrics, with applications to monetary and fiscal policy; most of my current work sits here, including the job market paper below. My research spans a few other areas too: during my master's I built a Bayesian neural network package, which we later used to quantify uncertainty in financial portfolios, and at the OECD I worked on measuring international trade, from transport and insurance costs to price indices."
toc: false
listing:
  # PhD thesis chapters — pulled from the working-paper and work-in-progress
  # folders by the `phd: true` flag, so a thesis chapter is authored as an
  # ordinary stub yet surfaces here (and is kept out of the two sections below).
  - id: phd-papers
    contents:
      - research/working-papers/*.qmd
      - research/work-in-progress/*.qmd
    include:
      phd: true
    template: ejs/research-item.ejs
    sort: "date desc"
  # Working papers that are NOT part of the thesis. `exclude: phd` drops the
  # thesis chapters; the section itself is hidden when nothing remains.
  - id: working-papers
    contents: research/working-papers/*.qmd
    exclude:
      phd: true
    template: ejs/research-item.ejs
    sort: "date desc"
  - id: publications
    contents: research/publications/*.qmd
    exclude:
      group: "OECD*"
    template: ejs/research-item.ejs
    sort: "date desc"
  - id: publications-oecd
    contents: research/publications/*.qmd
    include:
      group: "OECD*"
    template: ejs/research-item.ejs
    sort: "date desc"
  # Work in progress that is NOT part of the thesis (same pattern as above).
  - id: wip
    contents: research/work-in-progress/*.qmd
    exclude:
      phd: true
    template: ejs/research-item.ejs
    sort: "date desc"
---
